interpretation.SPY: Actual unleveraged tradable S&P 500 ETF total-return proxy, not the price-only index.
interpretation.QQQ: Actual unleveraged tradable Nasdaq-100 ETF total-return proxy, not the price-only index.

benchmarks.signal_anchor: previous observed XNYS session before the formal window start
benchmarks.execution: One full-capital buy at the first formal-window open in base, and the next session open in stress, using the same delayed prior-session signal convention as strategy accounts.
benchmarks.holding: Hold the acquired normalized fractional units through the final close; no recurring rebalance, fee-free synthetic purchase, or terminal liquidation.
benchmarks.prices: Use source-verified adjusted open and close from the same frozen panel, preserving raw price and corporate-action provenance. Never add dividends a second time to adjusted total-return prices.

metrics.net_returns: Account close-to-close returns after actual execution slippage and fixed commissions, including the initial deployment cost.
metrics.risk_free: Exactly the original frozen MarketData.risk_free series; do not reconstruct, rescale or silently replace it.
metrics.sharpe: Mean daily net return minus aligned risk-free divided by its sample standard deviation (ddof=1), annualized by sqrt(252), with the original undefined-variance rules.
metrics.cagr: Compound all net daily returns and annualize using 365.25 divided by calendar days from the previous XNYS session before the first return through the last return.
metrics.drawdown: Include the initial USD10000 peak before the first return; use the complete net equity path.

execution_disclosure.two_sided_turnover: Absolute executed purchase plus sale notional divided by pre-trade NAV, summed over actual executions; initial deployment included and separately identifiable.
execution_disclosure.annualized_turnover: Total two-sided turnover divided by the same elapsed calendar-year clock used for CAGR.
